rationale: pp-003 is the strongest match because it directly demonstrates DevSecOps pipeline standup and cloud migration to AWS GovCloud, both of which are explicitly required in the PEO C3T opportunity's scope for DevSecOps pipelines for firmware and network policy delivery and IL4/IL5 cloud environment experience. pp-005 is the second-best match due to its DoD client (Defense Health Agency), IV&V activities, and regulatory compliance documentation work, which maps to the opportunity's requirements for independent verification and validation of migrated network configurations and RMF authorization support at the Secret level. No third entry rose to the level of strong relevance: pp-001, pp-002, and pp-004 are all federal civilian engagements with no DoD mission domain, no tactical communications or network infrastructure work, and no SDR, spectrum management, zero-trust, or Army-specific technical elements, making them only superficially relevant at best. pp-005 was featured over pp-001 because a DoD IV&V and compliance background is substantively closer to Army tactical network verification requirements than a civilian tax data analytics migration.
